title: BBC Learning English from the News 2024 — Quiz 5
description: Choose the best answer for each question about vocabulary and usage.

elements.name: q41_slams_into
elements.title: A shopping trolley slams into a wall. How does it hit the wall?

elements.name: q42_mop_up
elements.title: Could you mop up the water by the sink? What are you being asked to do?
choices: Find out where the water came from

elements.name: q43_enough_is_enough
elements.title: “Enough is enough. Neighbours can't keep leaving rubbish here.” Why does the speaker say “Enough is enough”?
choices: To say the issue has already been resolved
To ask how much rubbish there is
To say the behaviour must stop
To say there is enough rubbish to recycle
elements.correctAnswer: To say the behaviour must stop

elements.name: q44_pose
elements.title: “A loose handrail can pose a risk to visitors.” Which word could replace “pose” here?

elements.name: q45_spit_your_dummy_out
elements.title: In informal British English, what does it mean if someone “spits their dummy out” after losing a game?
choices: They ask for another game politely.
They react in a childish way.
elements.correctAnswer: They react in a childish way.

elements.name: q46_reel_from
elements.title: Months later, the town was still reeling from the closure of its largest employer. How was the town affected?
choices: It was still shocked and unsettled.
It was unaware of the closure.
It was celebrating its economic growth.
elements.correctAnswer: It was still shocked and unsettled.

elements.name: q47_win_over
elements.title: Her clear explanation won over the sceptical audience. What did she achieve?
choices: Persuaded them to support her idea
elements.correctAnswer: Persuaded them to support her idea

elements.name: q48_from_the_sidelines
elements.title: Mina followed the dispute from the sidelines. How was she involved?

elements.name: q49_coming_for_us
elements.title: In a story, a character warns, “They're coming for us.” What does the character fear?
choices: The people mentioned plan to rescue them.
The people mentioned are waiting to be introduced.
The people mentioned have sent an invitation.
The people mentioned intend to target them.
elements.correctAnswer: The people mentioned intend to target them.

elements.name: q50_rallying_cry
elements.title: “Save our library!” became a rallying cry. What role did the phrase play?
choices: It announced a change to the library's hours.
It united people around a cause.
It ended debate about the library.
It explained how libraries are funded.
elements.correctAnswer: It united people around a cause.
